name: reserve-force
description: A grinding infantry fight with a reserve left behind. Germany holds 900,000 infantry against France's 500,000 and no fortifications, so a partial commitment leads to a battle that lasts several rounds while a substantial reserve is still sitting at home. INFANTRY on purpose: vehicles are gated by the oil capacity of wherever they stand, so `useableNaval` is recomputed the moment a force leaves the territory and a naval reserve can be grounded at the instant it is asked for -- which is correct behaviour and useless for testing the reserve path itself. Infantry is never gated, so what the territory holds is exactly what it can send.
